title: RequirementChecklist
description: The derived checklist. Decoded by internal/requirements/deriver.go; ids and statuses are assigned by code.

text.description: What the item requires, in English, one short sentence.

quote.description: The verbatim span of the request the item comes from.

forbids.description: Constraint only: the effects it rules out.

does.description: Write only: the effects the write itself is (send for a send), from the same list.
